title: Board of Governors Meeting Minutes
summary: The Board of Governors opened the 2026-27 BFL league year, reviewed the league's purpose and infrastructure, approved the inaugural season buy-in and prize structure, elected a Treasurer, and adopted several league rules and traditions.
highlights: The league's founding priorities were identified as fun, community, and consistency.
The BFL website was introduced as the league's central infrastructure and institutional record, with Discord serving as the primary communication space.
The Board approved a $20 buy-in for the 2026-27 season, establishing a $200 prize pool.
The approved payout structure is $125 for first place, $55 for second place, and $20 for third place.
Ian was unanimously elected to serve as BFL Treasurer.

The Board approved the Franchise Tag rule, allowing each franchise to retain one player for the following season in exchange for its first-round pick, with no player eligible to be franchised by the same team in consecutive seasons.
The Board approved adding a Punter roster position, though the proposal will need to be revisited because Yahoo does not currently support the position.
Conference assignments will be determined by an offline lottery conducted by the Commissioner.
The BFL Draft Lottery will be recorded and published through the BFL Discord server and website.
The BFL championship trophy will be renamed each year by that season's champion, with the new name applying to the following season's trophy.
actions: Conduct a Discord poll to finalize the in-person BFL Draft date.
Create a dedicated Discord channel for dues and payment administration.
Treasurer to establish the deadline for league dues.
Commissioner to conduct the conference assignment lottery.
Record the draft lottery and publish the video to Discord and the BFL website.
